research_notes: Blocked: official, member and candidate sources identify both public and private employers but do not establish employment durations or full-time fractions.
Targeted teaching/communications and early-date searches did not resolve dates; live APH open returned 403, so official preserved occupation text and search excerpt used.
Do not map teaching automatically to public schools, or contemporary school visits to former employers. Need CV/employer dates and hours for Education department, journalism, schools and consultancy.

Follow-up2026-10-02: recovered council-service break9 May2016–October2016 and second resignation27 May2019, plus mayoral subterms and school-teaching localities. These do not establish substantive FT employment totals.

Targeted school, department, journalism and consultancy searches yielded no dated CV or hours. Contemporary school/TAFE visits do not identify former employers.2015 council conflict declaration indicates part ownership of an unidentified establishment, not proof of consultancy identity or paid operational work; retain lead, no new employment inferred.

Next leads: named schools in Frankston/Geelong, historical education-department staff records and journalism bylines/employer archives; identify consultancy and ownership versus active work, then obtain date/hours evidence. All headline values remain null.

Third follow-up3October2026: targeted searches for Frankston/Geelong schools, Victorian Education communications, Geelong Advertiser/The Age bylines and the consultancy found no reliable dated CV, employer name or hours. Results about contemporary school visits and a different candidate's management consultancy were rejected. The available phrase that teaching was brief is too imprecise for an interval, and no school sector can be inferred. No material record or headline change; attempted avenues documented for later archival follow-up.
